policy_title: Dedicated Mental Health Professional in Every School
stated: Put a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every primary and secondary school, making sure all children and parents have someone they can turn to for help, funded by increasing the Digital Services Tax on social media firms and other tech giants.

source.quote: Put a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every primary and secondary school, making sure all children and parents have someone they can turn to for help, funded by increasing the Digital Services Tax on social media firms and other tech giants.

bearing_set.reason: Directly expands mental health access for children and parents by placing qualified professionals in every school — a real verdict on healthcare (mental health access indicator).
Children's mental health is a material driver of attainment and the attainment gap; in-school professionals plausibly affect educational outcomes, earning a real verdict on education & opportunity.

membership_note: The two main bearings are O3 (the designed-for healthcare access outcome) and O7 (education, via the strong evidence link between mental health and attainment). The DST funding mechanism is a business-tax lever; without a demonstrable funding gap it does not clear the O12 bar. Effects on O14 (inequality of access) are real but land as a distributional facet of O3/O7 rather than moving income/wealth-gap indicators independently.
